race.comment: SHARE THE STARS (6) resumes having gone to the paddock a dominant 3.5 length maiden winner at Werribee as favourite. Drawn wide here but finds a winnable race and should take plenty of beating provided she's forward enough - watch the late flucs. ROYAL HERITAGE (3) wasn't beaten far at Echuca last time out. He maps for a good run on speed and should give a sight. RACEY CASEY (10) has been about the mark this time in and rates an each-way chance having raced wide last time at Seymour. ALCOSHARE (4) is coming off a solid win in slightly easier, running out a good winner at Casterton. Gets every hope up on speed and can measure up.
